problem: Find the equation of the right-opening parabola that has its vertex at  $(0,0)$ and passes through the point $(8,-4).$
worked_solution:
The general standard equation of a parabola whose vertex is $(0,0)$ and whose arms open right or left is given by

$$
{y}^{2}=4px.
$$

Since we know the given parabola passes through the point $(8,-4),$ we can substitute $x=8$ and $y=-4$ into the standard equation and solve for $p:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ (-4)^{2} & =4p(8) \\ 16 & =32p \\ p & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the equation of the parabola is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {y}^{2} & =4(\frac{1}{2})x \\ {y}^{2} & =2x.\end{aligned}
$$
